description: Xbox Series compatibility layer tuned for NVIDIA RTX cards: Series X profile with DLSS upscaling, DLSS frame generation, F1 settings menu and F3 stats panel
notes: Copy victory.exe into your own game folder, next to game_scarlett_master.exe, and start it from there.
Settings, saves, logs and the DLSS/D3D12/FSR files it downloads live in %LOCALAPPDATA%\victory (override with VICTORY_HOME).
The exe is unsigned: SmartScreen needs 'More info' then 'Run anyway' on first start.
